references.text: Barak was previously called to gather ten thousand men from Naphtali and Zebulun at Mount Tabor, which is now reported to Sisera.
Barak's descent from Mount Tabor with ten thousand men follows directly after Sisera learned of his position.
Mount Tabor is mentioned as a boundary in the territory of the tribe of Issachar, the same mountain where Barak gathered his forces.
Tabor and Hermon are mentioned as mountains that praise the Lord's name, and Tabor was the site of this decisive event in Israel's history.
Barak is mentioned among the heroes of faith who by faith conquered enemies, including the victory over Sisera which began with this event.
